title: Road bike tire rolling resistance, wet grip and puncture tests
notes: Public road-tire table read 2026-11-01. One tire on a drum at 29 km/h with a 42.5 kg load; the free rolling-resistance figure is the "high" pressure for the measured width band (80 psi for 25-27 mm, 72 psi for 28-30 mm). Tubeless tires are tested without a tube and with sealant; tube-type tires with a butyl tube. Wet grip is a static wet friction coefficient x100 averaged over centre and edge on a 19 mm rim by default; it is not a braking-distance or cornering result. Puncture points combine sharp and blunt force with thickness. Other pressures and sidewall figures are members-only and were not used. No mainland-Chinese brand appears in the 183-tire road list.
